information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE0MDI2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--796bec32f0666d29384682342b18ff943a53d2ee/NMLogo.png) ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2025, denne gangen hold i Lierskogen. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2025, held in Lierskogen. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.
